title: C  Programming
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a building block of an OOP application."
An object is a building block of an OOP application.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mechanism, which allows exceptions to be thrown and caught."
Exception handling is a mechanism, which allows exceptions to be thrown and caught.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the term used to refer to functions exposed by objects."
Method is the term used to refer to functions exposed by objects.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means one object behaving as multiple forms."
Polymorphism means one object behaving as multiple forms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a control to display information to the user."
Label and link control is a control to display information to the user.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a basic part of a program."
A function is a basic part of a program.
fib: ______ are used by the .NET Framework to clean up after objects are no longer used.
Destructors are used by the .NET Framework to clean up after objects are no longer used.
______ is called the base class, and the class that inherits from the base class is called the derived class.
The parent class is called the base class, and the class that inherits from the base class is called the derived class.
______ is used to initialize the data by an object.
A constructor is used to initialize the data by an object.
______ are used when data is written to some external destination, which can be a physical disk file, a network location, a printer, or another program.
Output streams are used when data is written to some external destination, which can be a physical disk file, a network location, a printer, or another program.
______ is a notification that sometimes interrupts the normal program execution.
Exception is a notification that sometimes interrupts the normal program execution.
______ is the means by which the programmer can provide some functionality for that button.
Handling the event is the means by which the programmer can provide some functionality for that button.
